metadata.page_title: Nacua-Cola vs Two Buck Luck matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Nacua-Cola won by 9.4. Nacua-Cola left 6.7 lineup points on the table, while Two Buck Luck left 23.4.
summary.historical_summary: Nacua-Cola is 16-25 against Two Buck Luck across 41 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Two Buck Luck
summary.winner_reason: Nacua-Cola won by 9.4, led by a 27.5-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Puka Nacua (30.7) and Christian Watson (29.3).
summary.loser_reason: Two Buck Luck could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 27.5 points. Chase Brown scored 6.0. Its best legal lineup added 23.4, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
